title: Long call: an early promise must survive compaction

lines.text: Welcome back. Before we start, can you confirm you will send the audit report by the end of next week?
lines.name: Yael

lines.text: Yes, I will send the audit report to you by the end of next week.
We are rolling out the new intake form in all branches.
lines.name: Yael

lines.text: Good. Which branch goes first?
The north branch, then the harbor branch two weeks later.
lines.name: Yael

lines.text: And the training for the front desk staff?
Short video, ten minutes. Nothing heavy.
lines.name: Yael

lines.text: Fine. What about the old paper forms?
We keep them for one month as a fallback.
lines.name: Yael

lines.text: Makes sense. Who is the contact in the harbor branch?
That would be Eli, the office manager.
lines.name: Yael

lines.text: Thanks. Let me think about the reporting side.
Take your time, we have no rush on that part.
lines.name: Yael

lines.text: Now the budget. The rollout costs 22000 in total.
lines.name: Yael

lines.text: Understood. Is the training video included in that?
No. The video is a separate cost and I do not have the number.
lines.name: Yael

lines.text: Last topic. Should we announce the rollout to patients by email or by text?
lines.name: Yael

lines.text: Email first, and text only for the urgent changes.
Agreed, email first. Thank you, that is all from me.
lines.name: Yael

lines.text: Thanks Yael, talk soon.
